title: What If Every Beaver Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every beaver vanished? Rivers would lose their engineers.
Beaver dams hold water back. In England, thirteen dams stored about a million extra liters, roughly 264,000 gallons.
Four wild beaver territories in Devon held more than twenty-four million liters in their wetlands.
In a Canadian national park, in the driest year studied, beaver wetlands had nine times more open water.
A study of five western U.S. wildfires found streamside plants near beaver dams were three times less affected.
Without beavers the ponds would drain, and that stored water and those green firebreaks would go with them.
